reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The previously deprecated `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag has been removed in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `--clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag is no longer recognized and will be ignored; operators must migrate to using `--clustermesh-sync-timeout`.
consequence.remediation: Replace any use of `--clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` with `--clustermesh-sync-timeout` in Cilium agent configuration.

proposed.statement: The CLI flag `--clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` has been removed in favor of `--clustermesh-sync-timeout`.
